page_title: CAD 1-1 OSA | Cadiz CF v Osasuna 10/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' Mamadou Mbaye (Cadiz) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Sergio Herrera is prepared to thwart his effort.
90+8' Alex Fernandez (Cadiz) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
90+6' Brian Ocampo (Cadiz) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
90+6' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Cadiz CF for a penalty. Play continues.
90+3' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is behind the touchline and Osasuna will take a throw-in.
90+2' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) replaces Chimy Avila.
90+2' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nacho Vidal (Osasuna) comes onto the pitch for Ruben Garcia.
90+2' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) tries to catch the keeper off guard from long range, but the effort sails well wide of the right post.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) spurns a big chance! He makes himself some space to meet a cross and from near the penalty spot sends a header well wide of the left post!
87' We are about to witness a substitution. Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) is replacing Moi Gomez.
87' What was Juan Cruz (Osasuna) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
86' Brian Ocampo (Cadiz) strikes the ball goalwards from a mid-range free kick, but his effort only goes towards the middle of the goal and presents no problem for the goalkeeper.
86' Juan Martinez Munuera blows the whistle, Unai Garcia (Osasuna) is penalised for a foul. Cadiz CF will take a free kick.
84' Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Sergio Herrera, who smothers the ball.
83' What a huge chance for Roger Marti (Cadiz). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
81' The corner from Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) is intercepted by the defence.
80' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
79' Roger Marti (Cadiz) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
78' Here is a change. Aimar Oroz is going off and Jagoba Arrasate gives the last tactical orders to Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna).
77' Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle after Brian Ocampo (Cadiz) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
76' Here comes a substitution. Brian Ocampo (Cadiz) is brought on as a substitute for Ivan Alejo.
76' It will be a substitution. Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) is ready to enter the pitch as Chris Ramos walks off.
75' Sergio prepares a substitution. Javi Hernandez is replaced by Lucas Pires (Cadiz).
75' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for an infringement.
75' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
75' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Juan Martinez Munuera blows for a foul. Osasuna have a free kick.
72' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) but poses no threat.
70' 1 - 1 GOAL! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) strikes the penalty low down the middle and scores after the ball glances off the leg of Conan Ledesma.
69' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is going to take the penalty!
68' The referee gives a yellow card to Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
68' The Osasuna players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
68' Referee Juan Martinez Munuera makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Osasuna. Let’s see what happens!
68' That looked a certain handball by Mamadou Mbaye (Cadiz) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
66' A long cross into the box finds Chimy Avila (Osasuna) unmarked, but his header from the edge of the six-yard box is wild and goes miles wide of the left post.
63' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
63' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) goes for goal and shoots towards the left side of the goal, but his effort is well blocked.
62' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
59' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
58' That will be all from Darwin Machis who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz).
57' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Conan Ledesma reacts superbly to deny him.

56' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Conan Ledesma dived superbly to block the header from around the penalty spot, which was aimed straight towards the bottom left corner by Ruben Garcia (Osasuna).
52' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

52' Mamadou Mbaye (Cadiz) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. Cadiz CF get a corner.
50' The attendance is 18356.

48' Alex Fernandez (Cadiz) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Sergio Herrera!
48' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.

48' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Juan Martinez Munuera blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. It's a free kick to Cadiz CF, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
46' The linesman signals that Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
46' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Iker Munoz comes on the pitch for Lucas Torro (Osasuna).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

43' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out for a corner. Osasuna can continue in their attacking effort.
40' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
40' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Osasuna win a free kick.
37' An attempted cross from Chimy Avila (Osasuna) is cleared.
37' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) jumps into a tackle and Juan Martinez Munuera signals a foul.
35' A quickly taken corner by Osasuna.

34' That's unlucky! Chimy Avila (Osasuna) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Osasuna will take a corner.
31' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
29' Alex Fernandez (Cadiz) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.

26' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies inches wide of the left-hand post.

25' David Garcia (Osasuna) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Cadiz CF have a free kick.
22' Roger Marti (Cadiz) tackles a bit over-zealously and Juan Martinez Munuera blows for a foul.

19' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Roger Marti (Cadiz) makes it 1:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Ivan Alejo and planted his close-range header into the middle of the goal. Sergio Herrera was helpless.
15' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cadiz CF.
14' Conan Ledesma comes off his line to intercept the corner from Jesus Areso (Osasuna).

14' A great run by Ante Budimir (Osasuna) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender. Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
12' Unai Garcia (Osasuna) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
11' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Sergio Herrera is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
10' The free kick is taken by Darwin Machis (Cadiz), but ball is cleared.
9' Unai Garcia (Osasuna) has tested the patience of referee Juan Martinez Munuera and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
4' The linesman raises his flag. Roger Marti (Cadiz) is adjudged offside.
4' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Aimar Oroz (Osasuna). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
1' The first half has just begun.
Osasuna will kick-off.
Juan Martinez Munuera will supervise the game today.
